description.en: Smooth morphing notch and floating toast notifications for React powered by Motion.
description.zh: 基于 Motion 打造的 React 动效通知库，支持灵动岛顶栏贴合与浮动卡片形态的原位形变。

content.en: Notch Toast is a focused React notification library designed for deliberate feedback without stacking chaos. Powered by Motion, it renders a single active notification that smoothly morphs in place—supporting both an edge-attached notch mode and floating surface layouts across top and bottom screen alignments. It includes promise lifecycle states, accessible live-region announcements, and drop-in shadcn registry integration.
content.zh: Notch Toast 是一款专为克制且精致的交互反馈打造的 React 通知组件库。底层基于 Motion 构建，它改变了传统多条通知堆叠拥挤的模式，始终保持单条通知在视口原位进行丝滑的平滑形变（Morphing）；不仅原生支持类似手机「灵动岛」的屏幕边缘贴合切角模式与悬浮气泡形态，还完整覆盖了 Promise 异步生命周期、无障碍无干扰读屏播报与 shadcn CLI 快速安装机制。
